dhturbo.configuration.title: Turbo for Distant Horizons
dhturbo.configuration.enabled.tooltip: Generate distant terrain with Turbo for Distant Horizons instead of the Distant Horizons generator.
dhturbo.configuration.threads.tooltip: 0 = half of the CPU cores. One LOD tile is split across all threads. Takes effect after a restart.
dhturbo.configuration.full_resolution.to: Compute every LOD column instead of one in four. About 3x slower, sharper distant cliffs.
dhturbo.configuration.fake_trees.tooltip: Add approximate tree canopies to forests, so they are not bald until real chunks load.
dhturbo.configuration.real_trees.tooltip: On detailed LODs near the player, replay the game's own tree placement: trees stand where and as they will in the real world.
dhturbo.message.enabled: on, distant terrain from the terrain noise
dhturbo.message.disabled: off, the Distant Horizons generator works
dhturbo.message.clear_unavailable: nothing to clear: distant terrain only regenerates in singleplayer
dhturbo.message.clear_failed: could not clear distant terrain, see the log
dhturbo.configuration.share_worldgen.too: Server: send players with this mod the world seed and generation settings, so their client generates distant terrain itself. Turn off if players must not know the seed.
